# StorePilot

> AI App Store screenshot generator. Describe your app in one line and StorePilot writes the marketing copy, lays it out on device frames, and exports 24 full-resolution App Store screenshots — plus an ASO description and keyword list — in under 5 minutes.

StorePilot is a web app for iOS indie developers and small teams who need App Store Connect-ready screenshots without a designer. You type what your app does (and optionally upload one raw screenshot); an LLM generates headline copy for six conversion-oriented slide templates (hook, result, feature, pain, trust, CTA), an App Store Optimization (ASO) description, and a keyword list. You export pixel-perfect PNGs for every required iPhone display size.

## About

StorePilot is a standalone product focused on one job: turning a plain-language app description into a complete, upload-ready App Store screenshot set. It differs from generic mockup tools by generating the marketing copy and ASO metadata itself, not just framing images you already made. Free tier exports 3 watermarked screenshots; paid tiers remove the watermark and unlock unlimited full-resolution exports.
